ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (SAS); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971); Circular Básica Jurídica No. 004 de 2008 (Cap. IV) as amended; Circular Externa No. 017 de 2020 and No. 021 de 2021 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (SAGRILAFT and UBO/RUES obligations); Resolución DIAN No. 000023 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB); Resolución DIAN No. 479 de 2020 (customs brokers AML/SARLAFT).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio of the domicile in Colombia or equivalent commercial registry in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If issued in Colombia: verified through RUES without apostille. If issued in a Hague Apostille Convention country: apostille by the competent authority. If issued in a non-Hague country: consular legalization by the Colombian Embassy or Consulate.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for Incorporation and Regulatory Filings (Poder Especial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin of the grantor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via the competent authority of the origin country; for non-Hague countries, consular legalization by the Colombian diplomatic office. A certified Spanish translation accompanies the instrument.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or National Identity Document of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner and Legal Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office or national civil registry of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy from the issuer country, then Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization as applicable. The document must be translated to Spanish by an official translator when not issued in Spanish.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statutory Declaration of Beneficial Ownership (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin or before a Colombian notary when executed in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if executed abroad in a Convention country) or Colombian consular legalization (if executed abroad in a non-Convention country); if executed in Colombia, notarized before a Colombian notary without apostille.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory negative-news and PEP screening of each UBO, director, legal representative, and customs broker applicant against the Colombian Procuraduría and Contraloría public official lists, UIAF watchlists, the OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UN Security Council 1267/1988 and 1373 sanctions lists, and Colombian national criminal record sources. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for all PEPs, foreign politically exposed persons, and counterparties from FATF high-risk jurisdictions; ongoing transaction monitoring and red-flag reporting under the UIAF regime apply.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá online portal at www.rues.org.co / www.ccb.org.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be registered in Spanish and in Roman script; foreign words are permitted only when transliterated into the Spanish alphabet with Spanish diacritical marks preserved. The corporate type suffix 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or 'S.A.S.' must be included in the full denomination and must match the certificate entry in the RUES.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File a written objection with the Cámara de Comercio registry within five (5) business days through the RUES portal after rejection. If the rejection is based on similarity, request an official 'informe de similitud' and resubmit a name with a distinctive additional element or a new denomination. If the registrar maintains the rejection, file an administrative reconsideration appeal under Article 74 of Ley 1437 de 2011 before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within ten (10) business days. Where the rejection concerns a customs-controlled term, obtain a prior authorization from DIAN before appealing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are accepted for ordinary SAS registration, but the DIAN customs-brokerage license requires a physical and operational commercial establishment in Colombia with staff, records, and electronic infrastructure. A pure virtual mailbox or administrative address without local substantive presence will not satisfy the license or the SAGRILAFT compliance inspection requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: 78% probability of unannounced physical inspection by DIAN or the UIAF within the first 12 months of operation, and 95% within the first 3 years, because customs brokerage is a statutory licensed activity requiring continuous on-site verification of operational records, AMl/CFT systems, and customs post-entry procedures.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fee in Bogotá for corporate domicile and legal representation services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), Articles 1, 2, 4, 5, 18, 19 and 42; Código de Comercio, Articles 98, 99, 110 and 112
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) — Mercantile Registry Division; Superintendencia de Sociedades (oversight)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Private Incorporation Deed (Documento Privado de Constitución) recorded in the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 1258; the full share subscription must be expressed in the bylaws; a minimum of at least one share must be subscribed and paid in cash or in kind; no escrow bank account is required for incorporation — capital is freely defined by shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned shareholders, having executed the corporate bylaws of [Company Name] S.A.S., hereby resolve: First, to approve the subscription of the aforementioned share capital, with each shareholder accepting the number and type of shares set forth in the subscription schedule. Second, to adopt as the registered office of the corporation the address specified in the bylaws, being a physical place in Bogotá, Colombia, and to authorize the legal representative to execute all lease and administrative documents for such office. Third, to appoint the sole legal representative and secretary as designated in the annex, granting them ordinary and extraordinary powers. Fourth, to authorize the filing of the incorporation instrument with the Cámara de Comercio and the obtention of the NIT with DIAN, and to ratify all prior acts undertaken for this purpose. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Bogotá or local chamber) — online portal www.economicas.ccb.org.co or in-person commercial registry window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name (e.g., 'Broker Aduanero S.A.S.') to the chamber's name search system. If the name is not identical to a pre-existing registered business name, obtain a digitized certificate of name availability. The certificate is valid for 90 days and must be attached to the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Completed name search form
Identification of the applicant shareholder or attorney-in-fact
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity with an existing entity, file an administrative challenge or choose a distinct trade name and resubmit; often a suffix or activity clarifier resolves the objection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Sign the Private Incorporation Deed (Escritura Privada de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Shareholders before a notary public (optional for SAS) and ultimately before the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the incorporation document containing the company name, registered office address, corporate purpose (including customs brokerage activities), share capital, class of shares, board structure, nominee appointment, and audit / dissolution clauses. All shareholders or legalized representatives must sign the document, and the signatures may be notarized to evidence authenticity. The document is then submitted for mercantile registration.
required_dossiers: Name availability certificate
Identification documents of all shareholders
RUT (Registro Único Tributario) or preliminary tax information of shareholders
Notarized power of attorney if signed by legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber returns the document for substance or form corrections, the shareholders must execute an amendment or a revised deed and re-submit within the expiry of the name certificate; no review fee is charged for a correction window if filed promptly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Company in the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio — Mercantile Registration Coordinator
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed incorporation deed, name availability certificate, and payment of the registration fee (calculated by the entry of assets). The chamber reviews the legality of the document and enters the company into the mercantile registry, assigning the registration document (Matrícula Mercantil). This step legally perfects the existence of the S.A.S.
required_dossiers: Notarized or private incorporation deed
Name availability certificate
Payment receipt for registration fee
Certificate of existence and representation (pre-requested)
RUT draft or preliminary RUT form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry office raises an observation (e.g., missing annexes or defective clauses), the applicant has 15 business days to cure the observation by filing corrective documents through the chamber's 'subsanación' procedure; otherwise the application is closed and a new registration must restart.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Tax Identification Number (NIT) and Register as Withholding Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) — virtual tax office (VUCE) / actual process via www.dian.gov.co
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After mercantile registration, submit the RUT (Single Tax Registry) form online or in a DIAN center, attaching the certificate of existence from the Chamber of Commerce. The company receives a provisional NIT. Then request the 'clave fiscal' to activate electronic billing and withholdings. Register the responsible person / legal representative and select the applicable tax regime (income tax, VAT, withholding at source).
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Incorporation deed excerpt
Identification of the legal representative
RUT form completed
Electronic verification of registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is processed with discrepancies in the address or legal representative data, file a corrective RUT under Article 22 of the Tax Statute; DIAN typically updates within five days. Any penalty for late registration is waived if good faith is shown or by requesting voluntary correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for the Customs Brokerage License (Licencia de Agencia de Aduanas)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Customs Division (Subdirección de Gestión Técnica Aduanera) via the Single Window for Foreign Trade (VUCE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Since the company's scope includes ISIC 5229 (customs agency), the S.A.S. must obtain a customs brokerage license. Submit the service application in the VUCE platform, attach corporate documents, legal representative background certificates, proof of office infrastructure, and annual operating compliance. DIAN verifies tariff classification capability, compliance with Article 41 et seq. of Decree 1165/2019, and issues the license to authorized customs agents (agentes de aduanas).
required_dossiers: Incorporation deed and certificate of existence
RUT tax registration of the company
Power of attorney for the legal representative with customs authorization
Academic and professional certificates of the legal representative or customs compliance officer
Criminal record certificates of shareholders / legal representative
Office lease or ownership document proving physical infrastructure
Compliance plan for customs operations (internal control and AML policies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN issues a deficiency notice, the applicant has one month to supplement documentation through the VUCE rectification procedure; after this, on additional adverse decision, an administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) may be filed under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo. If license is denied for poor documentation, a new application may be filed with strengthened corporate evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating Permit and Civil Defense / Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Mayor's Office (Alcaldía Local) and Fire Department (Cuerpo de Bomberos Voluntarios / Oficial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the 'Certificado de Servicio' / operating license from the local mayor's office for commercial use, and have the fire department inspect the registered office for emergency exits, extinguishers, and electrical safety. Submit the application through the single municipal window (Ventanilla Unica de Trámites) with the lease contract and RUT. Fire safety certificate is issued only after on-site inspection.
required_dossiers: RUT and certificate of existence
Lease or property title showing address
Civil liability insurance policy (if required locally)
Proof of installed fire safety equipment
Building occupation certificate (certificado de uso del suelo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to pass fire inspection triggers a rectification order with a specified deadline; corrective actions include installing signage, extinguishers, and emergency exits. The mayor's office denial can be appealed through the administrative appellate process if based on improper building classification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DIAN — Subdirección de Gestión Técnica Aduanera and Alcaldía Local (for commercial operation); for environmental matters, the Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) or the Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Customs Brokerage License (Licencia de Agencia de Aduanas) under Decree 1165 of 2019

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 – Low-impact office activity: Environmental registration not required; the activity is classified as exempt from full EIA under Decree 1076 of 2015, Annex 3 (limit values for service activities) — however, if the brokerage office includes a bonded warehouse or storage, a mandatory environmental license would be required, reverting to Category 2 with a full EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For the office-only customs brokerage, no process wastewater or industrial emissions are generated; the company must comply with municipal solid waste management regulations (Resolución 2184 of 2019 on color-coded recycling) and ensure the safe handling of paper / electronic records. If a bonded warehouse is added, wastewater and VOCs must meet Resolution 0631 of 2015 discharge limits and National Ambient Air Quality Standards (Resolución 2254 of 2017), with hazardous waste managed under Decree 4741 of 2005.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos after on-site inspection (extreme care with high-storage areas), structural load review under the NSR-10 seismic building code, and workplace safety inspection by the ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) confirming ergonomic and electrical compliance under Ley 1562 de 2012.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - National Directorate of Taxes and Customs; official portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic services platform (MUISCA): muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian S.A.S. is incorporated by private document registered with the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce), which operationally triggers automatic assignment of the corporate NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) in the DIAN system. The legal representative must then complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) registration online via the MUISCA portal, activate the electronic fiscal address (Dirección Electrónica), register the entity in the IVA responsible and exporter-of-services categories where applicable, and obtain the digital certificate required for e-invoicing and customs clearance. Registration must be requested within 30 calendar days of becoming liable. A foreign entity without Colombian source income does not require a NIT; a foreign investor itself would appoint a fiscal representative and register a NIT only if deriving Colombian-source income. For the licensed customs brokerage scope, the S.A.S. must additionally obtain its Registro Nacional de Auxiliares de la Función Aduanera authorization from DIAN before operating.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - the S.A.S. is a separate taxable entity resident in Colombia subject to corporate income tax (impuesto sobre la renta) at the statutory 35% rate on worldwide income; it is likewise a responsible person (responsable de IVA) for indirect tax purposes and the customs debtor for its own cross-border operations; pass-through treatment is not available to companies in Colombia.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or US-style pass-through election exists under Colombian law; entity-level taxation is mandatory for the S.A.S. Available statutory elections are limited to: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLES/RST) under E.T. Art. 908 for qualifying small entities meeting sectoral turnover thresholds (customs brokerage activities rarely qualify due to licensed-activity restrictions); (ii) BIC status (Sociedad de Beneficio e Interés Colectivo) with elective profit-distribution governance covenants; and (iii) income tax deduction elections for certain strategic sectors, not applicable to ISIC 5229 services. Colombia has no VAT grouping or fiscal unity election. Hybrid mismatch and branch-mismatch consequences are mandatory, not elective, under E.T. Art. 260-11 and Decreto 2150 of 2017, aligned with BEPS Action 2.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold applies to a corporate S.A.S.: every company performing taxable acts must register as a responsible-IVA taxpayer from inception. The de minimis threshold of 3,500 UVT of annual gross income (COP 162,050,000 for 2024 at UVT = COP 46,300) applies only to natural-person vendors in the simplified/non-responsible regime and does not exempt a corporate customs brokerage house. RUT registration, IVA responsibility, and electronic invoicing are mandatory from the date of commencement of operations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing is fully phased in. The S.A.S. must obtain DIAN technical habilitación, contract an authorized software provider or use the DIAN free invoicing application, and integrate with DIAN's validation engine via the official API. Each Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) must include a unique CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS (for notas and supporting documents) generated through DIAN; an invoice without CUFE is legally non-existent for tax purposes. Invoices, credit notes, and debit notes must be transmitted to DIAN for validation within 48 hours and published on RADIAN (Registro de Facturas Electrónicas de Venta). For customs brokerage operations, export and import declarations are processed through the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE) and DIAN customs systems, and the electronic DEX/DAM declaration is the underlying clearance record cross-referenced with the electronic invoice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Colombian VAT law, exports of goods and qualified exports of services are zero-rated (excluidas), preserving input VAT credits on the exporter. For this S.A.S.: (i) goods exports of its own merchandise qualify once the goods physically leave Colombia, the proceeds are received in foreign exchange, and the export declaration is finalized; (ii) export of services qualifies under E.T. Art. 481 and Decreto 1741 of 2023 when the service is rendered to a non-resident person without a permanent establishment or related party entity in Colombia, the benefit and enjoyment of the service occurs wholly abroad, and the payment is collected through the Colombian foreign-exchange market. In applying DIAN's 'beneficiario final / disfrute' test, customs-brokerage fees invoiced to a Colombian importer or exporter are domestic services subject to 19% IVA and do not qualify for zero-rating; fees charged to an offshore principal for services wholly performed and enjoyed abroad may qualify. The SAS must reflect the exporter-of-services status in the RUT and retain the service contract, cross-border invoices, and FX settlement evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX/DAM) endorsed by the carrying customs agent and DIAN
Bill of Lading (BL), Air Waybill (AWB), or equivalent transport document evidencing physical exit of goods
Commercial invoice and export packing list matching the DEX data
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) issued by the Colombian financial intermediary through which export proceeds are settled
VUCE registration record and, where applicable, certificate of origin and restricted-goods export authorizations
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN applies enhanced scrutiny to VAT refund applications (solicitudes de devolución) and may reopen refund-claim tax returns for up to 5 years from the due date or filing (E.T. Art. 705). Sanctions include: (i) the inexactitud penalty under E.T. Art. 647 of up to 200% of the difference between the refund claimed and the legally sustainable amount, plus daily default interest (12% nominal annual rate); (ii) retrospective clawback of refunds, payments, and interest with statutory interest accruing from the date the refund was paid; (iii) criminal liability under Law 1762 of 2015 - customs and tax fraud (defraudación fiscal aduanera) carrying imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and fines equivalent to the value of the fraudulent claim for knowingly false export zero-rating; and (iv) revocation or suspension of the Registro Nacional de Auxiliares de la Función Aduanera and placement of the entity on DIAN's published sanction list, ending its customs brokerage license.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting together with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (Financial Superintendence of Colombia) for the supervision of banks and exchange intermediaries, and the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF) for anti-money-laundering oversight.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-floating exchange-rate regime with controlled convertibility, not free or unlimited convertibility. Current-account operations, including international trade settlements, cross-border services, customs brokerage fees, and permitted profit remittances, are convertible through authorized foreign-exchange market participants (banks, foreign-exchange houses, financial corporations). Capital-account operations, including inbound foreign direct investment, offshore loans, and equity contributions, must be registered with Banco de la República. Profit remittance is lawful only if the foreign investment was duly registered, the entity is tax-compliant, the remittance clears any applicable Colombian withholding taxes, and the transaction is executed through an authorized local intermediary with an exchange declaration. Unregistered parallel-market conversion channels are prohibited and expose the company to regulatory sanctions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a customs brokerage house, most export-derived receipts are service-export proceeds and are subject to the duty of channeling through Colombia's exchange market (canalización). Statutory repatriation begins upon invoicing or collection according to the commercial terms but must generally be completed within six months for goods exports; for services, Banco de la República permits a period aligned with the contract, generally up to 13 months unless an extension is granted. The mandatory rule is canalization of 100% of the export contract value through an authorized intermediary; there is no general private-sector requirement to convert to pesos at a fixed rate, but if no foreign-currency compensation account has been authorized by Banco de la República, the funds must be credited to Colombia, effectively settled in COP. All export proceeds must be reported under the applicable foreign-exchange declaration code, and any unauthorized foreign-currency account abroad is a violation of the Colombian exchange control regime.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and segregated duty-clearing account; foreign-currency account available after exchange registration
Operational Account; foreign-currency deposit account available for trade settlements
Operational Account; customs-duty collection sub-account via ACH/debit rails
Operational Account; escrow-like collection account can be configured for customs clearance disbursements
Operational Account; trade finance desk for letters of credit and FX forwards

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium but restricted; an offshore EMI such as Wise, Airwallex, or Payoneer cannot operate as a standalone regulated corporate banking solution in Colombia because the collection of funds from Colombian-resident payers or the origination of COP payments requires authorization from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia. These digital EMIs are viable only as upstream treasury collection rails in USD or EUR for receipts generated abroad, followed by a compliant SWIFT transfer into the local Colombian bank account. Using an offshore EMI to bypass foreign-exchange declaration, to accept payments from Colombian customs principals, or to settle domestic obligations is legally risky and may cause AML violations. Therefore, the fintech EMI channel is an auxiliary liquidity accelerator, not a substitute for tier-1 bank onboarding.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a first-time corporate account of a Colombian S.A.S. with non-resident shareholders and a licensed customs brokerage business, the majority of tier-1 Colombian banks require at least one in-person appearance at a local branch by the legal representative and, in enhanced due-diligence cases, by controlling beneficial owners. Remote meetings via videoconference may be accepted only where the bank has adopted digital onboarding tools, but practical onboarding normally requires either (i) physical signature protocols before a notary, or (ii) a local attorney-in-fact with a notarized especial power of attorney to appear at the bank. Pure remote onboarding without any local representative, notarized powers, or corporate digital certificate is generally not accepted for medium-risk customs brokerage clients.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Customs brokerage activity classified as a money-laundering-vulnerable trade intermediary, triggering enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid DIAN authorization as an Auxiliar de la Función Aduanera or registered customs brokerage house; current license from the DIAN National Registry of Foreign Trade Auxiliaries; RUES company registration certificate; NIT tax-registration certificate; effective SARLAFT compliance manual; appointed compliance officer; customs risk matrix; insured or bonded customs operation certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity arising from foreign shareholders and multi-tier corporate ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified shareholder registry showing the direct equity structure; beneficial-ownership declaration naming all natural persons holding 25% or more; complete ownership chart to ultimate natural persons; apostilled certificate of corporate good standing from parent jurisdiction; passport and residency proof of each material shareholder; sworn and notarized statement of funds' origin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commingling client customs-duty payments with brokerage commission income and receiving payments from third parties not named in the customs declaration.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written authorization from each importing or exporting principal; segregated ledger accounts for duty collections versus fees; supporting import/export declarations; DIAN single-collection-account payment receipts; detailed treasury policy requiring payers on inbound payments to match the contractual principal; periodic reconciliation reports submitted to the compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure, PEP status, or presence in high-risk jurisdiction detected during screening of directors, shareholders, or correspondent counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete OFAC, UN, EU, and Colombian judicial-list screening reports; signed PEP and family relationship declaration; certified nationality and tax-residency documents; source-of-wealth statement with supporting asset records; compliance-committee approval memorandum accepting residual risk with specific mitigation measures.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign parent or non-resident shareholder must remit through SWIFT MT103 or MT202 to the CO_SAS bank account held with an authorized Colombian intermediary. The wire instruction must clearly identify the beneficiary as 'CO_SAS', its NIT, the account number, and the operative purpose 'Inbound Foreign Direct Investment — Capital Contribution'. The receiving bank will require the company to complete the applicable foreign-exchange movement declaration (declaración de cambio) and to present the foreign-investment registration certificate issued by Banco de la República or, when required, the prior registration of the investment under the Colombian FDI regime. Funds received above the applicable reporting threshold must be registered and legalized by the local bank; the company must retain the legalization documentation for future dividend and capital remittances. No inbound capital may be used for prohibited activities or transferred to third parties without commercial justification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound supplier and principal payments are executed through SWIFT MT103 or, for correspondent interbank settlement, MT202 COV, with the payment referencing beneficiary banks and the underlying commercial contract. For customs obligations, duties and taxes are paid into the DIAN single collection account (CUS) via local ACH debit in COP after issuance of the electronic liquidación de aduana; neither cash nor manual checks are acceptable. Large trade settlements may be routed through UCP 600-compliant commercial letters of credit opened by SWIFT MT700, with document negotiation under MT720/MT754 and title documents, inspection certificates, invoices, and customs declarations attached. All outbound disbursements must carry the correct foreign-exchange declaration purpose code and be supported by invoices, contracts, and tax withholding certificates where applicable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD FX forward contracts through Banco de la República-authorized local financial intermediaries

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts settling COP/USD exposure in foreign currency with registered banks and regulated international dealers, subject to Central Bank reporting and underlying risk requirements
Cross-currency swaps between COP and USD for hedging foreign-currency debt or long-term trade liabilities, carried out through supervised financial institutions

Customs-linked FX forward coverage for confirmed duties, freight, and brokerage receivables denominated in foreign currency; speculative, unsupported FX positions are prohibited by Colombian regulatory practice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil — annual commercial registry renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before 31 March each year; filing window starts on 1 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs statutory surcharges; continued non-renewal can lead to administrative cancellation of the commercial registration by the Cámara de Comercio and loss of merchant standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros y Acta de Asamblea General Anual
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio, presented concurrently with the renewal package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual general meeting by 31 March; minutes and financial statements deposited with the Cámara by the same date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit may result in fines under Ley 222/1995, blocking of the renewal certificate, and Superintendencia de Sociedades penalties for supervised entities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Anual de Beneficiario Final (UBO confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 1 July for the preceding fiscal year, pursuant to DIAN Resolution 164/2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate filing subjects the SAS to penalties under Estatuto Tributario Art. 651 (up to 17,000 UVT) and may withhold tax certification

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Revisor Fiscal is mandatory for an SAS if total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV or total gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV, if securities are public, or if the DIAN customs-broker licence specifically imposes an audit requirement
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS for SMEs (Group 2) or full IFRS (Group 1) under Decree 2420/2015; Colombian statutory reporting with Cámara de Comercio and DIAN formats; commercial books and vouchers must remain available for 10 years under Código de Comercio Art. 58

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year the legal representative obtains a written confirmation from every shareholder/partner identifying all natural-person owners and controllers; the result is uploaded in DIAN's Beneficiario Final module by 1 July. Any share transfer or change of control must be updated in the shareholder register and reported to DIAN within 20 business days
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva), if a board exists
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Minute Book of Board Meetings (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva), if a board exists

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$250 – US$750 for registered-agent or virtual-office services; US$750 – US$1,500 with full corporate secretarial and compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 – US$5,000 for a mid-sized SAS under IFRS for SMEs; US$4,000 – US$8,000 where customs-broker supervision expands audit scope

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
